policy.note: Camera serves who is waiting, leaving, listening, choosing — not tourism.

markers.name: CAM_SH010_SISTER_CALL
markers.note: Invitation arrives; domestic closeness with a glimpse toward the sister she will refuse.

markers.name: CAM_SH010B_ATTIC_DOOR_CLOSES
markers.note: Refusal completed — doorway excludes sister.

markers.name: CAM_SH020_FATHERS_RECORDING
markers.note: Need crystallizes in the unfinished melody — intimate, not spectacular.

markers.name: CAM_SH030_ARCHIVE_BOX_OINO
markers.note: Name inheritance as object — discovery without classroom diagram.

markers.name: CAM_SH041_ANCESTOR_IGNORES_DINNER
markers.note: Embarrassing ordinary refusal — implication, not sermon.

markers.name: CAM_SH031_FAMILY_LINE_DOCUMENT
markers.note: Lineage as worn paper — artistic adaptation, not universal claim.

markers.name: CAM_SH040_ANCESTOR_SLEEVE
markers.note: Care as ordinary labour — watcher still able to mend.

markers.name: CAM_SH050_FACTORY_GATE
markers.note: Doorway becomes factory gate — history through bodies, not labels.

markers.name: CAM_SH051_ELECTRIC_HOUSEHOLD_TIME
markers.note: Benefit and cost together: relief of light, absence still present.

markers.name: CAM_SH060_SYNTHETIC_VOICE
markers.note: Care through technology — not memorial ghost; living person uses the tool.

markers.name: CAM_SH061_OINO_SEES_OWN_RECORDING
markers.note: She becomes watcher of her own controlled archive — shadow foreshadow without scare.

markers.name: CAM_SH070_TABLE_GLIMPSE
markers.note: Destination appears before arrival — ordinary sacred ahead; Zone unexplained.

markers.name: CAM_SH070B_ZONE_EMPTY_HOLD
markers.note: Patient empty space — nature unresolved.

markers.name: CAM_SH080_WARM_TWO_SHOT
markers.note: Genuine comfort — why she stays; protect performance.

markers.name: CAM_SH090_HAND_RESET_CONTROL
markers.note: Shadow as merciful grip — dread from control, not horror light.

markers.name: CAM_SH100_SISTER_REFLECTION
markers.note: Cost already present — loneliness in progress, not later warning.

markers.name: CAM_SH110_RELEASE_CONTROL
markers.note: Holy-fool hinge — ordinary costly release.

markers.name: CAM_SH110B_FATHER_LEAVES
markers.note: He finishes and goes — life beyond her desire.

markers.name: CAM_SH120_ACCEPTS_BOWL
markers.note: Nourishment accepted; presence without demanding forgiveness.

markers.name: CAM_SH121_SISTER_CHANGES_MELODY
markers.note: Real creative contribution — living variation, not symbolic child.

markers.name: CAM_SH122_OPEN_DOORWAY
markers.note: Final story image — invitation kept open (answers closed attic).

markers.name: CAM_SH130_TITLE_CARD
markers.note: Final film image — still; no trailer motion.
